stem.text: A sound wave of wavelength $0.50\,\text{m}$ passes through a doorway of width $1.0\,\text{m}$ between two rooms.
Which change increases the amount of diffraction that takes place?

A.text: Double the amplitude of the sound wave.

B.text: Double the width of the doorway.

C.text: Halve the frequency of the sound wave.

D.text: Halve the period of the sound wave.
